AMERICAN CONSULAR SERVICE
American Consulate General,
Shanghai, China, March 10, 1931.

Subject: Peter Tupikow and Wife, - Application
for Visa for Travel to the Philippine
Islands.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai, China.

Sir:

I have the honour to request such information
as may be available in your records regarding one Peter
Tupikow (Peter Toupikoff), born in Kherson, Russia,
who was a resident of Shanghai in 1929 and who is now
applying at the American Consulate General in Hongkong
for a visa for himself and wife for travel to the
Philippine Islands.

Your assistance in this matter will be
greatly appreciated.

I have the honour to be, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sgd. Douglas Jenkins
Consul-General

page_data.en:
Copy of detective report
dated March 26 on Mr. and Mrs. P. Tupikoff.
------------------------------------

Enquiries show that Peter Tupikoff is probably
identical with one Peter Afanasievitch Tupikoff who
has been known to the local Russian Emigrants'
Committee since 1929. When registering with the
Committee he gave the following particulars about
his antecedents.

    "Born in Kherson Province, Russia, on May 2,
    1902. Of the Russian Orthodox Creed. Single.
    Arrived in Shanghai from Portugal by the
    German S.S. "Typhoon" on March 19, 1929.
    Holds a passport issued by the Governor of
    Paramaribo, Dutch Guiana, on August 24, 1928
    and a certificate issued by the German
    Consul at Funchal on January 5, 1929. Has
    been working as a sailor on various ships
    since 1920. Has no acquaintances in
    Shanghai. Resides at 158 Avenue du Roi
    Albert".

Tupikoff made his living by casual work in
Shanghai until the summer of 1930 when he left for
Hankow in company with Mrs. K.L. Ghvanaky, née
Mihailovsky, wife of Mr. Ghvanaky, locksmith and
plumber, no.311 Route Tenant de la Tour. It is re-
ported that Tupikoff and Mrs. Ghvanaky kept a bar or
a boarding house in Hankow for some time. They went
together in the autumn of 1930 to Hongkong where,
it is said, they still pose as husband and wife.
page_data.zh:
3 月 26 日关于 P. 图皮科夫先生及夫人的
侦探报告副本。
------------------------------------

调查显示，彼得·图皮科夫（Peter Tupikoff）很可能
就是自 1929 年以来为当地俄国侨民委员会所知的
彼得·阿法纳西耶维奇·图皮科夫（Peter Afanasievitch Tupikoff）。
他在向该委员会登记时提供了以下关于其身世的详情：

    “1902 年 5 月 2 日出生于俄罗斯赫尔松省。信奉
    俄罗斯东正教。未婚。1929 年 3 月 19 日乘德国
    轮船‘台风’号（Typhoon）从葡萄牙抵达上海。持有
    1928 年 8 月 24 日由荷属圭亚那帕拉马里博总督签发的
    护照，以及 1929 年 1 月 5 日由德国驻丰沙尔领事签发的
    证明书。自 1920 年以来一直在各艘船只上担任海员。
    在上海无熟人。居住于阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）
    158 号”。

图皮科夫在上海靠打零工维持生计，直到 1930 年夏，
他随 K.L. 格万斯基（Ghvanaky）夫人（娘家姓米哈伊洛夫斯基
Mihailovsky）前往汉口。格万斯基先生是锁匠兼水管工，
住在坦能特·德·拉·图尔路（Route Tenant de la Tour）311 号。
据称，图皮科夫和格万斯基夫人在汉口经营了一家酒吧或
寄宿公寓一段时间。他们于 1930 年秋一同前往香港，据说
在那里他们仍以夫妻相称。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Mrs. Ghvansky arrived in Shanghai from
Harbin in 1929 with her husband. She worked as
a masseuse at Knige's Institute of Physical Culture,
No. 11 Seymour Road, until she eloped with Tupikoff.
It is said that she left her husband because he is
about fifty and she is only twenty two.

Mr. Ghvansky states that he had not been
divorced from his wife and therefore Tupikoff could
not be legally married to her.

On March 28, 1930 Tupikoff was brought before
the French Mixed Court on a charge of assault and
was sentenced to 15 days' imprisonment (sentence
suspended). This assault was committed by Tupikoff
on Ghvansky as the outcome of a quarrel over the
latter's wife.

There is nothing in Municipal Police records
to Tupikoff's detriment further than the above charge
of assault. Mrs. Ghvansky is generally regarded as
a person of good character in spite of the fact that
she has deserted her husband and is living with Tupikoff.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

格万斯基夫人于 1929 年随丈夫从哈尔滨抵达上海。
她在西摩路（Seymour Road）11 号的 Knige 体育研究所
担任按摩师，直到她与图皮科夫私奔。据说她离开丈夫
是因为他年约五十，而她只有二十二岁。

格万斯基先生表示，他并未与妻子离婚，因此图皮科夫
在法律上不能与她结婚。

1930 年 3 月 28 日，图皮科夫因袭击罪被提审至
法国混合法庭，并被判处监禁 15 天（缓刑）。此次袭击
是图皮科夫对格万斯基实施的，起因是两人就后者妻子
一事发生争吵。

除上述袭击指控外，工部局警务处档案中没有其他
不利于图皮科夫的记录。尽管格万斯基夫人抛弃丈夫并与
图皮科夫同居，但她通常被认为品行端正。

1 件附件：

page_data.en:
Copy.
A
PETER AFHANASIEVICH TUPIKOFF 28 years states:-
I am a Russian
national, born at Kherson, Russia on 8.5.1902. I was educated
at the High School in Ekaterinoslave. In 1915 I joined the
Russian Imperial Army as a cadet in the Medical Department. My
father Afhanasievich Tupikoff was a Colonel in the Russian Army,
he was killed by Bolsheviks in 1920. My brothers were also officers
in the Russian Army. When the trouble with the Bolsheviks started
in 1920 I left the Medical Department and had to serve as an
ordinary soldier. I left Russia in 1920 with General Wrangler's
Army and went to Constantinople. I was wounded twice in the right
leg and on arrival at Constantinople I was sent to hospital where
I remained for three months. On my discharge the army had already
split up and left for different places. I stayed on in Constantin-
ople for two years. During that time I worked as a labourer in a
Mineral Water Factory, in the Gas Works and also did other odd jobs
In 1922 I joined the Italian ship "Cicilia" in Constantinople as
ordinary seaman and did a three months trip to the Island of
Madeira off Portugal and back. I then joined the German ship
"Taifun" and worked on here as a seaman for two years, running
between Hamburg and the Argentine. I was paid off in Lisbon in
either January or February 1925. In Lisbon I joined another German
ship the S.S. "Holm" and served for two years and four months as a
seaman, running between Hamburg and Rio de Janeiro, calling at
Madeira. I left this ship in Madeira owing to sickness and was in
hospital for four months. On my discharge I joined one of the
Portuguese coastal steamers running between the Island of Madeira
and the Canary Islands. This ship was sunk in a typhoon and I lost
all my belongings, including my papers. The German Consul in Madeira
took pity on me and got me work on his farm there. I worked with him
for three months. On my leaving he gave me a letter of recommendation
to the Agents of the Nord Deutscher Lloyd in Lisbon and through them
I got a job on the S.S. "Bremen" and was discharged in Shanghai on
18.3.29. I stayed in Shanghai for one year, residing at No.12
page_data.zh:
副本。
A
彼得·阿法纳西耶维奇·图皮科夫，28 岁，陈述如下：-
我是俄罗斯
国民，1902 年 5 月 8 日出生于俄罗斯赫尔松。我在叶卡捷琳诺斯拉夫
（Ekaterinoslave）的高中接受教育。1915 年，我作为军医部的
候补军官加入俄罗斯帝国军队。我的父亲阿法纳西耶维奇·图皮科夫
是俄罗斯陆军的上校，他于 1920 年被布尔什维克杀害。我的兄弟
们也是俄罗斯陆军的军官。1920 年与布尔什维克的冲突开始时，
我离开了军医部，不得不作为一名普通士兵服役。1920 年，我随
弗兰格尔将军（General Wrangler）的军队离开俄罗斯，前往君士坦丁堡。
我的右腿两次受伤，抵达君士坦丁堡后被送往医院，在那里住了
三个月。出院时，军队已经解散并前往不同地方。我在君士坦丁堡
又待了两年。在此期间，我在一家矿泉水厂和煤气厂做劳工，也做
其他零工。1922 年，我在君士坦丁堡加入意大利船只“西西里”号
（Cicilia），担任普通水手，进行了为期三个月的往返葡萄牙马德拉岛
的航行。随后我加入德国船只“台风”号（Taifun），在此担任海员
两年，往返于汉堡和阿根廷之间。我于 1925 年 1 月或 2 月在里斯本
结账离职。在里斯本，我加入了另一艘德国船只“霍尔姆”号
（S.S. "Holm"），担任海员两年零四个月，往返于汉堡和里约热内卢之间，
途经马德拉岛。我因病在马德拉岛离开这艘船，并在医院住了四个月。
出院后，我加入了一艘往返于马德拉岛和加那利群岛之间的葡萄牙
沿海蒸汽船。这艘船在台风中沉没，我丢失了所有物品，包括证件。
德国驻马德拉领事同情我，让他在当地的农场为我安排了工作。我为
他工作了三个月。离开时，他给了我一份给里斯本北德意志劳埃德公司
（Nord Deutscher Lloyd）代理人的推荐信，通过他们，我在“不来梅”号
（S.S. "Bremen"）轮船上找到了一份工作，并于 1929 年 3 月 18 日在上海
离职。我在上海待了一年，居住在公平台（Kung Ping Terrace）12 号

page_data.en:
Kung Ping Terrace. I took up teaching German and French to
Russian children in Shanghai. I left Shanghai on 2.5.30, and
went to Hankow where I bought a Boarding House at No.22 Erh
Yao Road and ran it for about four months. I sold the boarding
house and left Hankow with the intentions of going to Canton to
find employment or to open a boarding house. I have between
$300 and $400. I arrived in Hong Kong on the S.S. "Asama Maru"
on 10.11.30, and am now staying at a Private Boarding House at
No.18 Granville Road. Miss E.L. Mikhailovskaia travelled on
the same ship with me. I have been living with her for one year
as man and wife. On arrival at the Boarding House in Hong Kong
the landlady would not allow us to occupy one room, I therefore
wish to marry her in Hong Kong. I stayed over in Hong Kong with
the intentions of looking for work. Miss E.L. Mikhailovskaia has
the offer of employment with Mrs. Beten in her Beauty Parlour.
I am in possession of a Certificate of Registration issued by
the Municipality of Hankow. This bears a transit visa through
Hong Kong to Canton given at the British Consulate-General, in
Hankow on 1.11.30.

(Sd) L.R. Whant.
12.11.30.                                A.S.I.
page_data.zh:
公平台。我在上海教俄国孩子德语和法语。我于 1930 年 5 月 2 日
离开上海，前往汉口，在那里我买下了二耀路（Erh Yao Road）22 号
的一家寄宿公寓，并经营了大约四个月。我卖掉了寄宿公寓，离开汉口，
打算去广州找工作或开一家寄宿公寓。我有 300 到 400 美元。我于
1930 年 11 月 10 日乘“浅间丸”号（Asama Maru）抵达香港，目前住在
格兰维尔路（Granville Road）18 号的一家私人寄宿公寓。E.L. 米哈伊洛夫斯卡娅
（Mikhailovskaia）小姐与我同船旅行。我已以夫妻名义与她共同生活
一年。抵达香港的寄宿公寓时，女房东不允许我们同住一间房，因此
我希望在香港与她结婚。我在香港逗留，打算寻找工作。E.L. 米哈伊洛夫斯卡娅
小姐已获得贝滕（Beten）夫人在其美容院工作的录用通知。
我持有汉口市市政当局签发的注册证书。上面有英国驻汉口总领事馆
于 1930 年 11 月 1 日签发的经香港至广州的过境签证。

（签名）L.R. Whant。
1930 年 11 月 12 日。                                A.S.I.

D.2148

Copy of detective report
dated March 26 on Mr. and Mrs. P.Tupikoff.
------------------------------------------

Enquiries show that Peter Tupikoff is probably
identical with one Peter Afanasievitch Tupikoff who
has been known to the local Russian Emigrants'
Committee since 1929. When registering with the
Committee he gave the following particulars about
his antecedents:-

"Born in Kherson Province, Russia, on May 2,
1902. Of the Russian Orthodox Creed. Single.
Arrived in Shanghai from Portugal by the
German S.S. "Typhoon" on March 19, 1929.
Holds a passport issued by the Governor of
Paramaribo, Dutch Guiana, on August 24, 1928
and a certificate issued by the German
Consul at Funchal on January 5, 1929. Has
been working as a sailor on various ships
since 1920. Has no acquaintances in
Shanghai. Resides at 158 Avenue du Roi
Albert".

Tupikoff made his living by casual work in
Shanghai until the summer of 1930 when he left for
Hankow in company with Mrs. K.L. Ghvansky, née
Mihailovsky, wife of Mr. Ghvansky, locksmith and
plumber, No.311 Route Tenant de la Tour. It is re-
ported that Tupikoff and Mrs. Ghvansky kept a bar or
a boarding house in Hankow for some time. They went
together in the autumn of 1930 to Hongkong where,
it is said, they still pose as husband and wife.
page_data.zh:
D.2148

3 月 26 日关于 P. 图皮科夫先生及夫人的
侦探报告副本。
------------------------------------------

调查显示，彼得·图皮科夫（Peter Tupikoff）很可能
就是自 1929 年以来为当地俄国侨民委员会所知的
彼得·阿法纳西耶维奇·图皮科夫（Peter Afanasievitch Tupikoff）。
他在向该委员会登记时提供了以下关于其身世的详情：-

“1902 年 5 月 2 日出生于俄罗斯赫尔松省。信奉
俄罗斯东正教。未婚。1929 年 3 月 19 日乘德国
轮船‘台风’号（Typhoon）从葡萄牙抵达上海。持有
1928 年 8 月 24 日由荷属圭亚那帕拉马里博总督签发的
护照，以及 1929 年 1 月 5 日由德国驻丰沙尔领事签发的
证明书。自 1920 年以来一直在各艘船只上担任海员。
在上海无熟人。居住于阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）
158 号”。

图皮科夫在上海靠打零工维持生计，直到 1930 年夏，
他随 K.L. 格万斯基（Ghvanaky）夫人（娘家姓米哈伊洛夫斯基
Mihailovsky）前往汉口。格万斯基先生是锁匠兼水管工，
住在坦能特·德·拉·图尔路（Route Tenant de la Tour）311 号。
据称，图皮科夫和格万斯基夫人在汉口经营了一家酒吧或
寄宿公寓一段时间。他们于 1930 年秋一同前往香港，据说
在那里他们仍以夫妻相称。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Mrs. Ghvansky arrived in Shanghai from
Harbin in 1929 with her husband. She worked as
a masseuse at Knige's Institute of Physical Culture,
No. II Seymour Road, until she eloped with Tupikoff.
It is said that she left her husband because he is
about fifty and she is only twenty two.

Mr. Ghvansky states that he had not been
divorced from his wife and therefore Tupikoff could
not be legally married to her.

On March 23, 1930 Tupikoff was brought before
the French Mixed Court on a charge of assault and
was sentenced to 15 days' imprisonment (sentence
suspended). This assault was committed by Tupikoff
on Ghvansky as the outcome of a quarrel over the
latter's wife.

There is nothing in Municipal Police records
to Tupikoff's detriment further than the above charge
of assault. Mrs. Ghvansky is generally regarded as
a person of good character in spite of the fact that
she has deserted her husband and is living with Tupikoff.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

格万斯基夫人（Mrs. Ghvansky）于1929年与其丈夫从哈尔滨抵达上海。她在西摩路（Seymour Road）11号克尼格体育研究所（Knige's Institute of Physical Culture）担任按摩师，直到她与图皮科夫（Tupikoff）私奔。据说她离开丈夫是因为他年约五十，而她仅二十二岁。

格万斯基先生称，他并未与妻子离婚，因此图皮科夫无法与她合法结婚。

1930年3月23日，图皮科夫因殴打罪被提至法国混合法庭受审，并被判处监禁15天（缓刑）。此次殴打系图皮科夫对格万斯基所为，起因是双方就后者之妻发生争吵。

除上述殴打指控外，工部局警务处档案中并无其他不利于图皮科夫的记录。尽管格万斯基夫人抛弃丈夫并与图皮科夫同居，但普遍被认为品行端正。
